result.reason: The revision minimally and appropriately extends subscription use to Affiliates and contractors and limits subscription revocation to the uncured-breach standard. However, Section 13.3 applies its revocation exception to any licence, which conflicts with Section 13.2’s requirement that paid-up licences be irrevocable. Successor transfer also remains conditional on Section 24 rather than being stated as an unconditional transfer right for successors or expressly for M&A transactions. The drafting is otherwise clear and preserves unrelated commercial intent, but the operative language does not fully reach the playbook position.
